atomic_deposit_rule: A0 opens ONE SaveService.transact_once with key soh.a3.meta_deposit.<proposal_id>.
A3 re-plans from candidate, removes exact physical tokens, marks them deposited, then calls port.apply_profile_delta(+amount).
A0 commits candidate once. Replayed key returns duplicate; interrupted write leaves old candidate intact.
No chest open, boss kill, home storage, death, expiry or reset may call apply_profile_delta without physical token custody at an authorized endpoint.
